claims.verbatim:
By the steamship Persia, at this port yesterday, we re-
ceived our European files containing interesting details
of our cable telegrams to the 11th of August.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 August 1866, p. 1, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Persia, Captain Lott, which left
Liverpool at 10 o'clock on the morning of the 11th, and
Queenstown on the evening of the 12th of August, ar-
rived at this port early yesterday morning.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 23 August 1866, p. 1, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Foreign News
BY
STEAMER.
Dates to August 12th.
The steamship Persia arrived at this port yester-
dry morning, from Liverpool on the 11th and
Queenstown on the 12th.

NEW YORK, Aug. 22.—The steamship Persia
from Liverpool on the 12th inst., has arrived.
